newsitem.title: FINLAND: PARTEK TO INCREASE PAPER PIGMENTS OUTPUT.
newsitem.headline: PARTEK TO INCREASE PAPER PIGMENTS OUTPUT.

text.p: Finnish construction materials and cargo handling equipment group Partek Oy Ab said in a statement on Thursday its Nordkalk unit will invest 20 million markka to increase paper pigments production by 25 percent.
"Most of the investment will occur in 1997," Partek said. "The company is prepared to invest an additional 20 million markka," it added.

"The use of different limestone-based pigments by the paper industry has been showing a sharp increase for several years," it said. Annual demand in Finland is around 800,000 tonnes, and is expected to rise to one million tonnes in the next few years.
"Our aim is to be able to supply, in amount and quality, the products that are needed by our customers in the paper industry at any time," Partek said.
Partek Nordkalk's Suomen Karbonaatti Oy subsidiary "holds a considerable market share of the limestone-based paper pigment market in Finland," it said, but did not elaborate.
